android.title: Back to the same poster
items: Genre, collection, actor and franchise pages: going back from a movie returns you to the same poster.
Pages with only movies or only series now show their total too.
Poster pages: a slim bar stays at the top while you scroll, with the page name, the total and the highlighted title.
Live TV: no more empty space above the channels.

android.title: Sports buttons
items: Sports: the buttons are round and easy to read again, and the team name is never cut off.
Sports: the Remind me button is gone.

android.title: The same icons on every device
items: The app's icons now look exactly the same on every TV and phone.
Settings: a clear blue sign for About.
Live TV: a smaller clock and date under the preview.
Phone: going back in the Premiere theme returns you to the same row instead of the top.

android.title: Live TV that remembers your channel
items: Live TV: going back to the channels (Right from the groups, or Left from the preview) lands on the channel you were on.
Live TV: the channel list moves in whole rows and always starts at the top - no more skipped or half rows.
Live TV: with the TV guide on, the clock and date under the preview always show.
TV guide: turning it off and on again shows the programmes right away.
Browse by Genre: each genre now shows every movie and series from all your TV services, not just the first 120 / 80.
Collections (Hidden Gems, Cult Classics, Family Movie Night and more) keep growing with every match from all your TV services.

android.title: Smoother Settings, guide and windows
items: Speed test: the needle no longer covers the speed numbers, and the result tiles show the full number.
TV guide: programmes never draw on top of each other.
TV guide: no box above the time grid, and Right from the groups goes straight to the channels.
Picture size and Subtitles windows close with one press of Back.
Exit: one press of Yes closes the app, cleanly.
Settings: no more jiggling while moving up and down; a headset icon for Help & about.
Title pages open at the top again (Back from "More like this" still returns to where you were).
Actors and Directors page: sorted A to Z.

android.title: A TV guide for every service
items: TV guide: when your service sends no program information, the app now finds the guide by itself from the free Dan's IPTV guide (Arabic channels such as MBC, Rotana and beIN, the USA, the UK, Canada, all of Europe and many more countries). Turn it on in Settings > Playback.
Works for M3U playlists too, and channels shown a few hours later (like "-6/hr") get their times shifted.
Settings: a new speedometer for the internet speed test, room under the last row of every group, the score-card buttons no longer cut off, and a clearer Help & about icon.
Subtitles & audio: a neater window with shorter language names.

android.title: Faster genres, every version from every account
items: Cinema Premiere: "Choose a version" now finds the copies on all your accounts, matched by the movie's own database number.
Browse by Genre opens quickly again, and the app uses much less memory with several accounts.
The "Recently Added" row is gone from the Premiere home.
Subtitles & audio: one press of Back closes the window.

android.title: TV guide, subtitle languages, all your accounts
items: TV guide: see what is on now and next in Live TV, plus a new Guide view with a time grid. Turn it on in Settings > Playback (off by default).
Movies and series: a "Subtitles & audio" button lets you pick the subtitle language (or Off) and the sound language when the video has them. Your choice is remembered.
Cinema Premiere now looks in all your Xtream accounts, and "Choose a version" shows which account each copy is on. Switching the account in use no longer causes errors.
Smoother on slower TVs: pictures of the next rows load ahead, rows are prepared before you reach them, and a Slow-TV mode gives older TVs a lighter look (automatic).

android.title: Keyboard fixed, neater Top 10 and Settings
items: Search keyboard: round capsule keys again, and the key you are on lights up and pops, so typing is easy to follow.
Top 10: every number is the same size, and number 1 always comes back with the same space at the left edge.
Settings: a more compact group list and a wider right side, so nothing is cut off.

android.title: Settings polish
items: Settings: every group lines up neatly, the sports buttons wrap instead of being cut off, and the stream format and keyboard switches are shorter and clearer.

android.title: New Settings, tidier top bar and keyboard
items: Settings on TV are redesigned in groups: My TV services, Home screen, Playback, Content & search, Internet, and Help & about. Pick a group on the left and its settings show on the right in soft cards.
Help & about now shows the app version and date.
Cinema Premiere: the top bar no longer runs over the "Cinema Premiere" name.
Top 10: the big number 10 now shows beside its poster.
Search keyboard: all the symbols of the TV keyboard, wider buttons for Space, Clear, 123 and Arabic, and one calm dark background.

android.title: Our own search keyboard
items: Cinema Premiere Search has its own keyboard on TV: rounded keys in English or Arabic, a 123 page, title suggestions while you type, your recent searches, and the most likely next letters glow gold.
Arabic is shown in the Noto Naskh Arabic font, and words spelled with or without hamza still match.
Settings: switch between Dan's IPTV keyboard and the TV keyboard.

android.title: Clearer settings, steady click
items: Technical Support: the Website button and code open the top of the website.
Settings: Today's games and Score cards now say clearly that they show on the photo themes only.
Photo themes: the click sound of the bottom bar now plays on every move, slow or fast.

android.title: Choose a version - every time
items: The "Choose a version" window now shows every time a movie or series has several versions, also right after the app starts.
Resume (Continue watching) offers the versions too: keep watching the same one, or switch to another version at the same point.

android.title: Search in Cinema Premiere
items: Cinema Premiere: a Search button in the top bar - find any movie or series in your library while you type.
Collection titles never split a word.
The version list no longer shows the provider's star symbols.
Cast & Crew: no grey box behind the highlighted actor.

android.title: Faster, smoother movement
items: Highlighted tiles pop out quicker, like Apple TV.
The soft background behind the Premiere rows costs the TV much less work while you move.
Fixed: the test version 185 did not open on some TVs.

android.title: Test version (not released)
items: A smaller test build; it did not open on some TVs and was replaced by 186.
Highlighted tiles pop out quicker, like Apple TV.
The soft background behind the Premiere rows costs the TV much less work while you move.

android.title: Choose a version
items: When your service has the same movie or series more than once (4K, Full HD, HD, with or without subtitles, dubbed...), Play now lets you choose the version you want.
Title pages show how many versions are available.
Popular Actors and Directors: a "See more" tile opens a full page with many more actors and directors from your library.
Cleaner actor circles (no grey box when highlighted) and collection titles that never split a word.

android.title: Cleaner rows + website link
items: Premiere on TV: a little more space between each row title and its cards, the same in every row.
Phones: the volume button in the player no longer covers the time.
Technical Support: a Website button and QR code (downloads and update history).
Phones: after this update the app opens on the Cinema Premiere home once (you can still pick another look in Settings > Themes).

android.title: Bigger highlight
items: Premiere: the highlighted poster, card, collection or group pops out bigger, so it is easy to see where you are.

android.title: Back to the same title, no flicker
items: Title pages: after opening a title from "More like this", Back returns to the same tile on that row - no flicker, no jump to the top.
Cast & Crew and More like this rows remember how far you scrolled.
Settings: the clock is now a simple "24-hour clock" On / Off switch.

android.title: Faster, smoother Premiere
items: Title pages open at once again (no more waiting, no more being thrown back to Home).
The whole app runs faster on big services: titles are matched much more quickly and with less work.
Up and down on the Premiere home: one smooth glide, every time.
The version date on the home screen is correct again.

android.title: 12 or 24-hour clock
items: Settings: choose a 12-hour (3:45 PM) or 24-hour (15:45) clock. Every clock and game time in the app follows it.

android.title: Smooth up and down
items: Premiere home: moving up and down is now one quick, smooth glide - no more jitter. Each row moves to the top of the screen.

android.title: Small loading fix
items: A section with no titles now simply shows as empty.
Safety guard: if the Premiere home ever fails to load twice, it pauses for a day so the rest of the app keeps working.

android.title: Premiere home no longer closes the app
items: Fixed: on some TVs the app closed itself while the Premiere home was loading.
Movie and series lists load with much less memory, so big services work smoothly.

android.title: More space between tiles
items: Premiere: tiles keep a clear space between them, also when highlighted, like Apple TV.

android.title: Opens the right movie or series
items: Premiere now opens the exact movie or series from your service (the 2026 one, not an older title with the same name), for every provider.
Apple TV-style cards: no frame, a soft shadow and a small Movie / Series line on the highlighted poster.
Cast & Crew with plain round photos, like Apple TV.

android.title: Back to your highlights
items: Sports Hub: after watching a game highlight, Back returns to the Highlights tab on the same clip.

android.title: Apple TV-style highlight
items: Premiere: the highlighted poster pops out with a soft shadow, like Apple TV.
IMDb scores on the featured titles and title pages.
Continue watching shows the whole poster.
New Collections design: words and posters side by side, never overlapping.
Up from My List goes to More info, then Watch now, then the top bar.

android.title: Premiere: Sports, Back and title pages
items: Sports in the Premiere top bar.
Back takes you to the same row and tile you were on, not the top bar.
Watch now is outlined like More info until you highlight it.
Title pages show the whole cast row on the first screen.
Highlighted tiles never get cut off at the edge of the TV.
Phones: volume control in the player (speaker button, slider panel, mute, or slide along the right edge).
Phones: Sports Hub buttons show every word; big scores stay on one line.
Phones: cleaner Collections cards, Tonight's Pick tiles and page titles.

android.title: Cinema Premiere polish
items: TV: the Premiere home opens on the top bar, so the whole first page shows.
Smaller Watch now / More info / My List buttons; Down from My List starts at Continue watching.
The top bar only moves Left and Right and never jumps to the other end.
One smooth background under the first page.
Going back up on any Premiere page now shows it all the way to the top.

android.title: Cinema Premiere and Sports Hub
items: New Cinema Premiere home on TVs and a full Sports Hub.

android.title: Cinema Premiere, Prime-style
items: The new home is called Cinema Premiere.
A see-through menu in the middle of the top bar, stacked buttons and small dots for the featured titles.
Left / Right flip the featured title; each one stays 5 seconds.
Pressing Down moves the whole first page away so the rows have the full screen.

android.title: Premiere: more for you
items: Because you watched, Recommended for you, Tonight's pick, Got 90 minutes, Epic Nights.
Popular actors and directors, and movie franchises, each with their titles from your library.

android.title: Premiere: collections and genres
items: Award collections (Oscars, Golden Globes, Emmys), seasonal picks and a Browse by Genre row.
A full title page with cast, trailer and More like this.
Premiere is listed first in Settings > Themes.

android.title: Premiere: faster and easier to move around
items: The Premiere home loads much faster and opens at once the next time.
The top menu can now be reached with the remote.

android.title: New Premiere home (TV)
items: A new premium home for movies and series: a moving featured title, Top 10 rows and Continue watching.
TVs switch to it once; phones can choose it in Settings > Themes.

android.title: Sports Hub: channels and alerts
items: Shows which channels carry each game.
Remind me before a game starts, score alerts for your teams, and game highlights.
Today shows only today's games; a game page opens at the top.

android.title: Sports Hub: real game clocks
items: Live games show the real clock and period.
NFL and WNBA added; standings split into East / West conferences.

android.title: New Sports Hub
items: A full Sports screen from Home and the side menu: scores, schedules, standings and team pages.

android.title: Smoother sync and ratings for everyone
items: Continue watching sync is lighter and only downloads your list when something changed.
IMDb scores use their own service for the public app.

android.title: Live games on the sports card
items: A live game of your teams looks like the live games list (score in the middle, clock under it).
Tighter spacing on the home sports card.

android.title: Easier TV Settings
items: In TV Settings, Left / Right stay in the row and never jump to another row.
The side menu no longer opens from Settings; Back goes Home.

android.title: One Back button for every phone
items: Phones: a round Back button (black circle, light-blue ring, white arrow) that looks the same on every phone brand.

android.title: Fast-forward through long lists
items: TV remote: the ⏩ and ⏪ buttons jump through long channel lists and poster grids (Live TV, Movies, Series, Settings).
Inside the players the buttons keep their own job (skip forward / back).

android.title: Recently watched stays honest
items: Live TV grid: resting on a channel no longer adds it to Recently watched - only channels you open full screen are added.

android.title: Season bars that never disappear
items: Series posters: the season / episode bar stays while the app checks for a newer episode.
A lookup that fails is tried again, and many more series are remembered.

android.title: NEW episode bar everywhere
items: The green NEW season / episode bar shows on series posters in every section: its own section, Recently Added, Favorites and search.
New episodes are checked again every 6 hours.

android.title: Calm Settings + compact sports card
items: TV Settings opens without a jump, Back keeps your place, and Up always returns to the top.
"Exit the app?" closes the app instantly.
New compact sports card on the left: your teams with the day and time (a countdown when the game is soon) and a sport drop-down.

android.title: Settings opens without a jump
items: TV Settings opens calmly with no sliding; Back closes an open form first.

android.title: Settings Up / Down without flicker
items: Up / Down in TV Settings jump straight to the next row, with no flicker.

android.title: Exit fixes
items: The Exit the app? question now closes the app on Yes, and starts on No.

android.title: Exit question + one sports card
items: Back on Home asks "Exit the app?" so a second Back by mistake never closes it.
One sports card with team logos; the hourly weather line is gone.

android.title: Add a service with your provider
items: Settings: MAC Address + Device Key + a QR code to add a service through your provider's website.
Live TV grid plays the channel you rest on, inside its tile.
New slim weather + clock bar.
Hide categories lists every saved account.

android.title: Add with Device ID and Device Key
items: Each TV shows its own Device ID and Device Key, so a provider's website can add your playlist.

android.title: Hide categories for every service
items: Hide categories now lists every saved account and playlist.

android.title: Live preview in the channel grid
items: In Grid view the channel you rest on plays inside its tile.
Weather and clock in one glass card on the TV home.

android.title: Clear watch history
items: Settings: Clear watch history (under Hide categories) - clears this device only.
The TV home-screen picture is back to the original.

android.title: New TV home-screen picture
items: A full-width picture on Android TV / Google TV home screens (changed back in 143).

android.title: Small polish
items: ✨ Recently Added icon.
The account in use shows all its details.
Matching icons in the Hide categories list.

android.title: My TV services
items: TV Settings: one "My TV services" section for all your logins and playlists.
Icons for Xtream (📡) and M3U (📋) lists in the Live TV menu.

android.title: My TV services in Settings
items: One clear "My TV services" section at the top of TV Settings.

android.title: Your login is always safe
items: Adding something with your phone never replaces your login.
All your accounts are in the Live TV list menu.

android.title: Add from your phone
items: TV: sign in or add a playlist from your phone by scanning a QR code.

android.title: Add a playlist with your phone
items: Scan a QR code on the TV and type the playlist name and link on your phone.

android.title: Phone sign-in easier to find
items: "Sign in with your phone" now sits at the top of TV Settings.

android.title: Phone + Hide categories polish
items: Phones: a bigger "Continue from" window.
Hide categories: the provider list is on top.

android.title: Several accounts
items: Save several Xtream accounts and switch between them.
Hide categories works for every list.

android.title: Sign in with your phone
items: TV: scan a QR code and type your login on your phone instead of the remote.

android.title: Phone fixes
items: Phones: playlist addresses can be edited, and small fixes.

android.title: Phone welcome + sports
items: Phones: a longer welcome screen and sports cards on every theme.

android.title: Player fixes + gold welcome
items: Phones: Picture size works with taps, drag the time bar to jump, a gold welcome screen.

android.title: Telegram support on TV
items: Technical Support: contact the developer on Telegram (QR code).

android.title: Phone fixes + Telegram
items: Phones: update windows fit upright, a Back button on the players, Telegram support.

android.title: New phone design
items: Phones get their own upright screens (Home, Live TV, Movies, Series, Settings); players turn sideways. TVs unchanged.

android.title: Update window fits phones
items: On phones the update window always fits, with the Download and install button visible.

android.title: Account name
items: Settings: the name of your account is part of Manage profile.

android.title: Full-size phone icon
items: The app icon on phones is full size again; TVs keep their home-screen icon.

android.title: Support window + updates
items: The Technical Support window fits every TV.
Hide categories: Done keeps you on that row.
Updates are checked from this download page.

android.title: Support window fixes
items: The Technical Support window keeps its title and text in view.
Done in Hide categories stays on its row.

android.title: Update messages
items: The update message also shows when you come back to the app.
The Updates button moved to the bottom-left corner.

android.title: Smoother screens, Hide categories, self-updating app
items: The app downloads and installs its own updates.
Settings > Hide categories; Live TV group names without star symbols.
Technical Support with a QR code.
No black fade between screens.

android.title: Ratings, grid view, steadier player
items: Title pages show the age rating and IMDb score.
Live TV Grid view.
Section counts saved and shown at once.
A freeze after waking the TV fixed; the player kept on its steadiest settings.

android.title: Continue watching on every device
items: Stop a movie or episode on one device and finish it on another.
Sharp backgrounds for movies and series, instant Back.
Live channels that stall reconnect quietly.

android.title: Trailers, themes and weather
items: Trailer button on movie and series pages.
Long names slide sideways while highlighted.
Eagle Lake theme; weather shows at once and retries by itself.
A fresh install opens on Home without asking for a login first.

android.title: Games widget, backgrounds, Picture size
items: Today's games on Home (NFL, NBA, MLB, Soccer).
Backgrounds from TMDB when the provider has none.
Picture size menu; the player shows the time left.
"Show more" for long stories, Arabic text from the right.

windows.title: Smoother sync and ratings for everyone
items: Continue watching sync is lighter: it only downloads your list when something changed, so it keeps working smoothly for everyone.
IMDb scores are remembered on your PC for a week, so title pages open with the score right away.

windows.title: Live games on the sports card
items: Home sports card: a live game of your teams now looks like the live games in the list (score in the middle, game clock under it, in red).
Home sports card: tighter spacing, so more games fit without scrolling.

windows.title: Website button in Technical Support
items: Settings > Technical Support: a button opens the download page with the update history.

windows.title: Sharper look + wheel scrolling
items: Home: the mouse wheel over the sports card scrolls the games list.
Sharper look: Windows' own screen font (Segoe UI), smooth new Home icons, team logos at the size they are shown.

windows.title: ✨ Recently added icon
items: Movies / Series: "Recently added" uses the same ✨ as the TV app.

windows.title: Live scores in place, rows in full
items: Home sports card: a live game's score stays in its row.
Continue watching and Recently watched channels show in full.

windows.title: Faster posters + new Home
items: Faster Movies / Series: posters stay on screen while the season bars come in, a section you already opened shows at once, and resting the mouse on a section gets it ready before you click.
Smoother Live TV list scrolling.
New Home like the TV app: a slim weather + clock bar and one sports card with your teams and today's games (sport drop-down + Yesterday / Today / Upcoming).

windows.title: New app icon
items: The gold IPTV shield icon, the same as the TV and phone app.

windows.title: Season bars remembered
items: Series posters: season / episode bars are remembered between starts, and a failed lookup is tried again.

windows.title: NEW episode bar everywhere
items: The green NEW season / episode bar shows in every section, checked again every 6 hours.

windows.title: Every account in Hide categories
items: Hide categories: every saved Xtream account has its own Live TV / Movies / Series; 📡 / 📋 icons.

windows.title: Switch accounts from Live TV
items: Live TV: your other Xtream accounts are buttons next to Search.
Rename each playlist and account in Settings.

windows.title: Hide categories polish
items: The "List:" row is above Live TV / Movies / Series.

windows.title: Easier scroll bars
items: Home: thicker scroll bars under Continue watching and Recently watched channels.

windows.title: Several accounts
items: Save more than one provider login and switch between them.
Every account and playlist has its own hidden categories.

windows.title: Telegram support
items: Technical Support: a Telegram button.
The highlight of the first poster column is no longer cut off.

windows.title: Account name at sign-in
items: Enter your account name in the sign-in window.

windows.title: Whole posters
items: Title pages show the whole poster; the poster highlight shows on all four sides.

windows.title: Updates inside the app
items: "Download and install" installs a new version and opens the app again - settings, favorites and login stay.

windows.title: Continue watching everywhere, ratings, Hide categories
items: Continue watching across your devices.
Age rating + IMDb score; Live TV Grid view.
Hide categories; Technical Support; an Updates button.

windows.title: Trailers, themes, score cards
items: Trailer button (real trailers only), Eagle Lake theme, sliding long names.
Weather shows at once and retries; choose your teams for the score cards.

windows.title: TV guide, corner player, more channels play
items: TV guide with catch-up, Channel check, a small corner player.
4K / HEVC channels play; Picture size; time left in the player; TMDB backgrounds.
